translations.item: Sign in to the CEA App
The CEA App on %s is asking to sign in to your account.
Check that this code is the one shown in the app:
If you didn't just ask to sign in from the app, close this page.
Done! You are signed in. You can close this page and go back to the app.
We couldn't sign you in with that passkey. Try again.
The passkey request was cancelled. Try again when you are ready.
This browser doesn't support passkeys. Open this page in another browser.
This page needs JavaScript to ask for your passkey. Enable JavaScript in your browser, or open this page in another one.
This sign-in request has expired or was already used. Go back to the app and start it again.
